help:
🏃 CoachBot — your running coach (5K to marathon)

Setup
/goal 2027-03-14 3:59 Hanoi Marathon — race date, goal time (optional), name
/goal 2026-12-20 half 1:45 — distance: 5k, 10k, half, marathon or e.g. 15k
/profile days=5 long=sun maxhr=188 born=1990 lang=en — training profile
/connect — connect COROS (or mock data)
/sync [full] — pull data now (full = last 8 weeks)
/plan — generate a plan for approval

Daily
/today · /week · /daily · /status · /report
/feedback <text> — how you feel (any message works too)
/soreness 0-10 · /symptom — report a symptom
/pause · /resume

I adjust small things automatically (you can undo) and ask before any major change.
disclaimer: ℹ️ CoachBot gives training guidance, not medical advice. Stop and seek medical help for chest pain, fainting, unusual breathlessness or worsening pain.
start.configure_chat_id: 👋 This bot is not configured yet. Set Telegram__AllowedChatId={0} in .env and restart, then send /start again.
goal.usage:
Usage: /goal YYYY-MM-DD [distance] [goal time] [race name]
Distance: 5k, 10k, half, marathon (default) or e.g. 15k. Time: H:MM[:SS], or MM:SS for short races.
Examples:
/goal 2027-03-14 3:59 Hanoi Marathon
/goal 2026-12-20 half 1:45 VnExpress Half
/goal 2026-11-29 5k 22:30
goal.invalid_date: The race date must be in the future and within 2 years.
goal.saved: 🎯 Goal saved: {0} ({1}) on {2}, {3} weeks away · target time {4}. Next: /sync full to load your history, then /plan.
goal.invalid_time: That goal time does not fit the distance. Use H:MM (e.g. 1:45 for a half) or MM:SS for short races (e.g. 22:30 for a 5K).
goal.invalid_distance: Supported distances are 3 km to the marathon (42.195 km).
profile.show:
Profile: {0} run days/week · long run on {1} · max HR {2} · born {3} · language {4}
Change with /profile days=5 long=sun maxhr=188 born=1990 lang=vi
plan.generating: ⏳ Building your plan from your recent training…
plan.no_goal: Set a race first: /goal YYYY-MM-DD [goal time] [name]
plan.internal_validation_failed: The generated plan failed an internal safety check, so it was not saved. This is a bug; please report it.
plan.infeasible_race_too_soon: The race is too soon to build a plan for. Pick a later race with /goal.
plan.infeasible_too_short: Not enough time to prepare safely for this distance from your current training. Consider a later race or a shorter distance.
plan.infeasible_low_base: Your recent volume is under 10 km/week. Build a base first: run 3×/week consistently for 4–6 weeks, then try /plan again.
plan.warn_short: Less preparation time than recommended for this distance: the plan is compressed. Prioritise finishing healthy over a time goal.
plan.warn_low_base: Your current volume is low for this distance. Consider run-walk intervals or a shorter race first.
plan.warn_little_history: Less than 4 weeks of run history: the starting load is an estimate. Tell me if it feels too hard.
plan.warn_default_volume: No recent runs found, so the plan starts conservatively at 15 km/week.
plan.proposal_stats: Week 1: {0} km → peak {1} km/week · longest run {2} km · cutback every 4th week · {3}-week taper
plan.prediction_goal: ⏱ Your current fitness predicts about {0} · your goal: {1}.
plan.approved: ✅ Plan approved and active. I'll send your workout each morning. /week shows this week.
plan.rejected: Plan discarded. Adjust /goal or /profile and run /plan again.
plan.not_pending: That plan is no longer waiting for approval.
plan.orphaned_on_coros: These workouts from your previous plan are already in your COROS calendar. COROS tools cannot delete them, so please remove them in the COROS app:
zones.basis.coros_threshold: Targets based on your COROS threshold pace.
zones.basis.coros_marathon_prediction: Targets based on your COROS marathon prediction.
zones.basis.estimated_from_runs: Targets estimated from your recent runs.
zones.basis.heart_rate: Targets use heart-rate zones (no reliable pace data).
zones.basis.rpe: Targets use perceived effort (no pace or heart-rate data).
zones.estimated_from_runs: Paces are estimated from training runs and are probably conservative. A COROS fitness test would sharpen them.
zones.max_hr_estimated: Max HR is estimated from age, which can be off by ±10 bpm. Set it with /profile maxhr=… if you know it.
zones.rpe_only: No pace or heart-rate data: workouts are prescribed by effort (RPE).
zones.goal_too_ambitious: Your goal time is more than 5% faster than your current fitness predicts, so training paces use your current fitness. We'll revisit as you improve.
workout.desc.rest: Rest day. Light walking or mobility is fine.
workout.desc.long: Steady and easy; practise fuelling and hydration.
workout.desc.tempo: 2 km warm-up, {0} km at tempo effort, 2 km cool-down.
workout.desc.interval: 2 km warm-up, {0} × 1 km hard with 2–3 min easy jog, then cool-down.
workout.desc.race_pace: Easy start, {0} km at goal race pace, easy finish.
workout.desc.race: Race day! Start conservatively and fuel early.
workout.rpe.easy: Effort 3–4/10, can talk in full sentences
readiness.level.green: 🟢 Readiness: good to train as planned.
readiness.level.amber: 🟠 Readiness: some fatigue signs; keep today controlled.
readiness.level.red: 🔴 Readiness: strong fatigue signs; prioritise recovery.
readiness.missing: No recent data for: {0}. Missing data is never treated as a good sign.
analysis.unplanned: This run wasn't in the plan; it still counts toward your load.
analysis.flag.easy_too_fast: Easy run was faster than target. Easy days should feel easy so hard days can be hard.
analysis.flag.hr_above_zone: Heart rate was above the target zone (heat, fatigue or pace).
analysis.flag.cut_short: Shorter than planned. That's fine; don't make up the distance later.
analysis.flag.long_cut_short: Long run was cut short. Don't add the missing distance to other days.
analysis.flag.ran_longer: Longer than planned. Keep extra volume small to avoid overload.
analysis.llm_concern: ⚠️ Something you mentioned may be a symptom worth checking. If anything feels wrong, use /symptom.
analysis.ask_rpe: How hard did that feel? (1 = very easy, 10 = maximal)
adapt.red_day: Strong fatigue signals: easing the next session.
adapt.amber_day: Some fatigue signals: softening the next hard session.
adapt.deload: Several days of fatigue signals: proposing a lighter rest of the week.
adapt.fitness_improved: Your threshold pace improved: proposing updated (faster) quality-session paces.
adapt.fitness_declined: Your threshold pace slowed: proposing easier quality-session paces.
rec.auto_applied_header: 🔧 Small adjustment made (tap Undo to revert):
rec.expires_hint: If you don't answer within {0} h, the plan stays as it is.
rec.expired: That proposal expired; the plan was left unchanged.
rec.expired_notice: ⌛ A proposed change expired without an answer, so the plan stayed unchanged: {0}
rec.no_longer_valid: That proposal no longer fits the current plan, so nothing was changed.
feedback.usage: Tell me how you feel: /feedback legs heavy, slept badly
feedback.rpe_high: Effort {0}/10 saved. That's high; I'll take it into account for the next days.
feedback.soreness_high: Soreness noted. If it's sharp, localised or getting worse, use /symptom.
symptom.ask: What's going on? (Not medical advice: if in doubt, see a doctor.)
symptom.button.cardiac: Chest pain / fainting / palpitations / unusual breathlessness
symptom.button.injury: Sharp or bone pain / swelling / limping
safety.cardiac: 🚨 Stop training now. Chest pain, fainting, palpitations or unusual breathlessness need urgent medical assessment. If symptoms are happening now or are severe, call emergency services (115 in Vietnam).
safety.injury: 🛑 Stop running for now. Sharp or bone pain, swelling or limping can mean an injury such as a stress fracture. Please see a doctor or physiotherapist before running again.
safety.illness: 🤒 No training while you're ill, especially with fever or symptoms below the neck. Rest and recover; we'll restart gently.
safety.no_red_flag: Thanks for telling me. Nothing in that looks like a red flag. If anything worsens or feels wrong, stop and get it checked.
safety.plan_paused: Your plan is paused and nothing more will be sent to COROS. When you're symptom-free (and cleared, if needed), use /resume.
safety.no_active_plan: You have no active plan, so there's nothing to pause.
pause.done: ⏸ Plan paused. Use /resume when you're ready.
resume.confirm_symptom_free: Your plan was paused because of a symptom. Are you symptom-free, and cleared by a professional if you saw one?
resume.done: ▶️ Plan resumed. Start gently; I'll watch your recovery closely.
report.no_plan: No active plan yet. Use /goal and /plan.
daily.missed: {0} planned session(s) were missed. They won't be made up; we just carry on.
daily.unconfirmed: ❓ No run synced for yesterday's {0}. Forgot the watch, or skipped? Just tell me.
daily.red_advice: Suggestion: rest or a very easy 20–30 min today. Recovery is training too.
daily.missing_data: Little recent watch data (sleep/HRV/HR). Wear your watch overnight so I can judge recovery.
daily.ask_rpe: How hard did your last run ({0} km) feel? (1–10)
weekly.volume: Volume: {0} km (planned {1} km, last week {2} km)
weekly.recovery: HRV {0} ms (prev {1}) · resting HR {2} (prev {3}) · sleep {4} h/night
weekly.easy_too_fast: {0} easy runs were faster than target this week. Slow them down to recover better.
sync.done: 🔄 Sync complete: {0} new activities, {1} days of health data.
push.manual_action: ⚠️ COROS tools can't delete or reschedule workouts. Please update these manually in the COROS app:
push.skipped.no_active_plan: ⌚ Nothing to send to COROS (no active plan).
push.skipped.plan_paused: ⌚ Plan is paused: nothing sent to COROS.
push.skipped.not_supported: ⌚ Your COROS connection doesn't offer workout scheduling, so workouts stay in Telegram only.
connect.mock_mode: Running on mock COROS data (Coros__Mode=mock). Set Coros__Mode=mcp and restart to connect your real account.
connect.browser:
⌚ Connect COROS:
1. Open: {0}
2. Sign in to COROS and approve.
3. If the page you land on doesn't load (normal when the bot runs on a server), copy the full address from the browser and send it here.
connect.done: ✅ COROS connected: {0} tools available · workout scheduling: {1}. Loading the last 8 weeks…
connect.failed: That link didn't complete the COROS login (expired or already used). Try /connect again.
connect.disconnected: COROS disconnected; stored tokens removed. You can also revoke access in your COROS account settings.
alert.coros_reconnect: ⌚ Your COROS connection expired or was revoked. Use /connect to reconnect.
alert.sync_failing: ⚠️ COROS sync has failed {0} times in a row. Recovery decisions are on hold until data flows again (/status for details).
plan.designed_by_llm: 🤖 Diagnosed and designed by the AI coach for your goal (workouts tailored to your limiters), then checked against every safety rule.
plan.llm_rejected: The AI coach's version did not pass the safety checks, so this plan uses the rule-based version.
adapt.llm_easing: Coach suggestion based on this run and your recovery:
adapt.llm_progression: 📈 You're absorbing training well — proposed progression (only applied if you approve):
safety.confirm_symptom: You mentioned "{0}". Just to be safe: are you experiencing this now or after recent runs?
symptom.button.yes_current: Yes, I have it — pause my plan
